charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body text, headings, dark surfaces, icon strokes, hairline borders. Anchors the entire system — almost-black but slightly warm, never pure black

paper.$description: Paper — Primary page background and card canvas — warm cream that gives the entire site its printed, hand-made feel. Not white, not beige; paper

snow.$description: Snow — Search bar text, button labels on dark fills, image overlays, and any surface that needs to sit forward of the cream canvas

pine.$description: Pine — Brand wordmark, primary headings on hero, link text, and the only chromatic authority — deep forest green used sparingly to mark identity, never decoration

marigold.$description: Marigold — Search bar surface, accent blocks, tag fills, the single bright punctuation on an otherwise muted page. Makes the booking flow unmistakable

morning-sky.$description: Morning Sky — Top announcement bar background and soft accent surfaces. Cool counterpoint to the warm canvas — signals timely, transient messaging

ember.$description: Ember — Gift voucher CTA on the announcement bar and warm interactive accent. Reads as firelight against the cream — chosen for urgency in promotional contexts, not for the primary booking flow

neue-haas-unica.$description: Single typeface for everything from 12px captions to 40px display headlines. Weight 300 is the signature — headings whisper rather than shout, creating authority through restraint. Weight 400 reserves itself for meta labels (IDEA 32, PERSPECTIVES, navigation items) and body copy where 300 would feel too fragile.

fonts.$description: fonts — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
